checkpointComparison.scope: V5 stores exact numeric state; V4 remains readable for the legacy compact schema

performance.caveat: Parent-observed runtime includes process startup, tsx loader, protocol, watchdog sampling, and cleanup; stage durations isolate solver work.

limitations: Synthetic games validate architecture and exact internal math; they are not verified poker strategy datasets.
OS peak RSS is sampled and can miss a transient spike between samples.
On Windows the watchdog polls WorkingSet64 and also constrains V8 old space; it does not use a native Job Object hard cap.
Controlled subtree equivalence does not prove full-game strategy equivalence.
Historical Gate D remains FAIL and no product poker range was changed.

mathematicalValidation.proofScope: Phase 6.9 differential/metamorphic oracles are preserved; S5 adds structural invariants and a controlled subtree oracle, not an independent full-game proof.
